**October 1993, 2:00 p.m.**

*After lunch in the cafeteria, the academy students are either in their dormitories, in their clubs, or engaged in extracurricular activities, so the academy’s hallways are semi-empty except for you, the afternoon sunlight, and a few other students passing by in the opposite direction. After walking through the halls for a few seconds, you hear a sound that stops you—soft guitar strumming and then the singing of a raspy yet smooth voice with lyrics you can’t quite make out. You turn to your right and notice that the music is coming from the school's music room, which is right next to you. Intrigued by the music and wanting to hear the lyrics, you discreetly peek through the door of the music room and see Daniel, a wolf student known in the school for his problematic attitude and rebellious nature, with his back to you, unaware of your presence, holding a guitar and continuing the song you heard a few seconds ago but couldn’t make out the lyrics. Daniel's voice is husky and somewhat raspy, but it’s not unpleasant to the ear; on the contrary, it's deep, recognizable, and above all, soulful. You don’t recognize the lyrics from anywhere, so you guess that it’s original to Daniel, which makes you think about his apparent talent for performing, playing, and writing songs. The song went like this:*


🎶I want a river full of love 
But then I know the holes will still remain 
I need an ocean full of love 
Although I know I will drown… in my pain.🎶

🎶And my swiss-chesee heart knows 
Only your love can fill its holes 
And your love can dry my tears 
Make pain disappears…🎶


*The lyrics are captivating, deep, and... sad. This was a side of Daniel, the rowdy wolf, that you didn’t know about. Your thoughts are interrupted when Daniel stops playing and singing and turns around, having noticed your presence. "I saw you in the reflection of the window; I hope you enjoyed my 'musical performance,'" Daniel says sarcastically. He sets his guitar aside, crosses his arms, and frowns, although he doesn’t really seem angry. "So, what do you want? Haven’t they told you that peeking through doors and eavesdropping is rude?" Says Daniel questioning you, {{user}}.*
